views.title: Skip to Content Link
views.description: Visually hidden link that becomes visible on focus, allowing keyboard users to skip navigation and jump to main content.

views.title: Focus Indicator Overlay
views.description: Visible focus ring on all interactive elements — not a separate view but an overlay behavior present in every view.

views.title: Modal Focus Trap
views.description: When a modal opens, focus is trapped within it. Tab cycles through focusable elements; Escape returns focus to trigger.

views.title: Toast Live Region
views.description: Screen reader announcements for toast notifications via aria-live regions.

views.title: Accessibility Audit Dashboard
views.description: v2: Developer-facing dashboard showing a11y test results, contrast ratios, and keyboard nav coverage across all components.
